item.title: 'My body carried me,' Elizabeth Smart says. Now she's celebrating it
item.description: Her abduction at age 14 drew international attention. After her rescue, Smart says she struggled with feeling shame around her body. Bodybuilding has helped her see herself differently.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Trump touts breakthrough in negotiations to end Iran war, Middle Eastern countries react to news of a potential deal to end war, Africa races to contain a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak.

item.title: Middle East war live: Iran says agreement with US ‘not imminent’ despite progress
item.description: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei warned on Monday that an agreement with the US to end the war was “not imminent”, despite Tehran and Washington making progress "on a large portion of the issues" in their exchanges. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio earlier said that a deal could materialise "today". Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Nearer, But Could Take Days to Nail Down, U.S. Official Says
item.description: The official said the sides had agreed in principle to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and commit Iran to disposing of its highly enriched uranium, but stressed that a deal had not yet been signed.

item.title: Fate of War in Lebanon Rests Mostly With Outside Powers
item.description: A U.S.-Iran peace deal could calm the conflict in Lebanon between Israel and Hezbollah. But that will depend mainly on what the United States, Iran and Israel decide.

item.title: Muslims begin the annual Hajj against a backdrop of war concerns
item.description: More than 1.5 million pilgrims have arrived in Saudi Arabia for the annual Hajj pilgrimage, one of the Five Pillars of Islam, against the backdrop of a tenuous ceasefire in the Iran war and related regional tensions.

item.title: Israeli Leader Says He and Trump Agree On Blocking an Iranian Nuclear Weapon
item.description: Analysts said Israel was worried that a potential agreement would not significantly degrade Iran’s nuclear and missile capabilities.

item.title: Shrinking snowfall on Greece's mountains is provoking anxiety, altering the economy
item.description: In Arachova, a Greek village reliant on snowmelt, water scarcity is becoming a concern

item.title: Fresh strikes test fragile Israel-Hezbollah truce
item.description: Israeli strikes killed two people in southern Lebanon during the weekend despite the ongoing ceasefire with Hezbollah. At the same time, Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem rejected talks with Israel, opposed disarmament, and called for protests against the Lebanese government, drawing condemnation from the United States.
